dendromatic: Processing, Cleaning and Normalization of Dendrometer Time Series

Source: R/dendromatic-package.R
dendromatic-package.Rd

Tools for point-dendrometer data pipelines: ingest raw logger tables of any shape into the 'treenetproc' L0 format, process to L1/L2, correct sensor relocations and jumps with growth-aware level shifting, erase dormancy periods and align growing seasons, merge consecutive series from the same tree, extract predawn and midday tree water deficit extrema, and match leaf water potential campaigns to stem features. The computational core behind the 'DendroMatic' Shiny applications, usable standalone in scripted workflows.
